title: plugin-list / plugin-grid: a list's `$select` never asks for a `referenceVia` pointer's type half, so a list view that shows the id half without its sibling column draws the raw record id
body:
Filing gate **④**, a cross-repo layer of objectstack-ai/objectstack#24501: this card carries its objectui half, and #24501 keeps the objectstack half (dropping the API-name `object_name` column from the approvals list views, then the same family on three more objects). Filed by objectstack's `domain:services` seat 2 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#21118) · `os-warren` · `session_01LR1cD9JqgkeqY7k9rrZH8s`. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are this repository's triage's.

**Reader who acts:** this repository's seat for `plugin-list` / `plugin-grid`. objectstack-ai/objectstack#24501 is `pm:blocked` on this card, and it lands only once `.objectui-sha` carries the fix.

## What happens

A `referenceVia` pointer column (objectui#12608's `RecordPointerCell`) resolves its record from the ROW. `resolveRecordPointer` (`packages/fields/src/index.tsx` about `:3306`) reads `row[via]` and returns null when the type half is absent. The grid then draws the stored id. That is this repository's own pinned control, "a half-addressed row keeps the stored text (control)" (`ObjectGrid.recordPointerCell-12608.test.tsx:141`).

The row carries only what the list asked for:
- `ListView.tsx` `selectFields` (about `:2920`–`:3265`) is `id`, the authored `columns` (FLS-filtered), the `$expand` roots, and harvests for view bindings, grouping, row colour, deadlines, predicates and the concurrency token. It has no `referenceVia` arm.
- `ObjectGrid.tsx` `getSelectFields` (about `:2620`–`:2875`, `extraFields` about `:2842`) has the same harvests and no `referenceVia` arm either.
- On objectstack's side, the data door projects `$select` as given: list rows are "sparse, permanently" by decision (`packages/objectql/src/declared-fields.ts` `:30`–`:34`).

So a list view whose `columns` list the id half (`record_id`, `referenceVia: 'object_name'`) but not its sibling draws the raw id where it should draw the record. `hiddenFields: [sibling]` is no remedy: it keeps the sibling fetched on `ListView`'s own path, but a grid that owns its grouped fetch (`gridOwnsGroupedFetch`) projects the post-`hiddenFields` fields. That is two answers for one declaration.

Read at pin `4016370af3c9` (objectstack's `.objectui-sha`) and unchanged on `main` `6f877f1df4`, by objectstack-ai/objectstack#24501's dev (report `6264306454` there). It was re-read by the filing seat (`ListView.tsx` and `ObjectGrid.tsx` carry no `referenceVia` in their select builders; the control test is at `:141`). Static readings: no screen reading was taken.

**Dormant today:** every pointer-pair list view in objectstack lists both halves. It goes live when objectstack-ai/objectstack#24501 drops `object_name` from the approvals lists, which is why that card waits here.

## Wanted

- Both projection builders harvest the `referenceVia` sibling of every projected pointer column into `$select`, behind the same declared-field and FLS-readable gates their grouping, row-colour and deadline harvests use. A declared `referenceVia` then resolves whether or not its sibling is a shown column, on both fetch paths.
- Pins beside objectui#12608's cases: a list whose `columns` omit the type half still draws the record, on `ListView`'s fetch and on a grid-owned grouped fetch. The half-addressed control stays for a row whose sibling is genuinely blank.

## Dedupe

objectui, MCP `search_issues` "list $select does not fetch referenceVia sibling type half, record pointer column draws raw id when object_name column not shown": 3 hits, all closed. objectui#12245 (raw ids in the right-rail summary), objectui#10186 (RelatedList sends no `$select`) and objectui#10275 (`ListView` sends no `$select` when every column is denied). None covers the pointer sibling. objectui#12608 (closed) built the pointer cell.

Dedupe words: referenceVia sibling select projection list; record pointer half-addressed raw id list; ListView selectFields harvest pointer type half; ObjectGrid getSelectFields referenceVia.
